title: A failed check names the findings an earlier check had repaired and the build undid since, before its next step
steps: S1: a build log of two checks — native-structure on post/100 .post_content plus looks-finished, then looks-finished alone — and a third verdict with native-structure on post/100 again and look-kept new.
S2: the same log shapes with a finding never repaired, a finding new at this check, a looks-finished finding, and only one check before.
S3: eight no-demo-words findings repaired at the second check and all back at the third.
expect: S1: findingsCameBack names native-structure (post/100 .post_content) as back after check 2; the next starts 'These came back after check 2 had them repaired' and carries the template-guard sentence.
S3: six named and 'and 2 more'; no guard sentence.
evidence: Local round 31 (25/10/2026, WordPress): native-structure findings went 9 → 3 → 9 → 9 → 3 over five checks; replayed on that log, check 4 now names the tags_input findings check 3 had repaired.
fence: checkVerdicts; findingsCameBack (FINDING_NAMES, looks-finished left out); cameBackNext (GUARD_CHECKS)

tests: a finding repaired at one check and back at the next is named, with the template guards said once
a finding seen for the first time, one never repaired, and the vision model findings do not come back
only guard checks bring the guard sentence; at most six are listed
